sections.title: Transport eligibility
sections.text: All full-time Beacon Works employees are eligible for regular cab transport regardless of grade or distance from the office.

sections.title: Night shift safety escort
sections.text: For women employees at Beacon Works, drops after 10 PM require a security escort. An escort is not required by this rule for a drop exactly at 10 PM.

sections.title: Booking and change cutoff
sections.text: Beacon Works cab bookings and shift changes must be requested at least 4 hours before the scheduled trip. Late exceptions require the site admin's approval.

sections.title: Weekend and holiday travel
sections.text: Beacon Works provides Saturday pickups without manager approval for rostered shifts. Sunday and public holiday pickups are not offered.

sections.title: Airport trip approvals
sections.text: Airport cab trips at Beacon Works require prior approval from the finance manager. The approved airport trip cost cap is INR 2500 per trip.

sections.title: No show penalties
sections.text: At Beacon Works, two no-shows within a calendar month lead to a written warning. A third no-show in the same month leads to a 3-day suspension of cab booking access.

sections.title: Guest travel
sections.text: A registered business guest may use a Beacon Works cab with site admin approval. Family members may not use employee cabs.

sections.title: Ad hoc trip requests
sections.text: Beacon Works ad hoc office cab trips require site admin approval and have a cost cap of INR 1200 per trip.
